summary.intent: Plan Phase 25 (Desktop Enhancements) of CipherBox v1.1 by running discuss-phase to capture implementation decisions, then plan-phase to generate executable PLAN.md files covering Tauri auto-updates and TEE file enrollment.
summary.outcome: Phase 25 fully planned with 3 PLAN.md files in 1 wave, research and validation artifacts committed to feat/phase-25-desktop-enhancements branch, with both checker warnings resolved (Windows restart UX accepted, VALIDATION.md corrected to match cargo check commands).

repo: TEE IPNS key wrapping for folders already exists in crates/fuse/src/write_ops.rs (~line 499) — folder creation wraps IPNS keys with tee_public_key and sends encrypted_ipns_private_key + key_epoch on publish, but file-level enrollment is missing
tauri.conf.json has no updater section — Tauri v2 updater plugin not yet configured
Per-file IPNS is already implemented — files have their own IPNS names in metadata
TEE enrollment uses IpnsPublishRequest struct with encrypted_ipns_private_key and key_epoch fields (crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs)
Phase 25 requirements: DESKTOP-01 (TEE file enrollment) covered by plans 02+03, DESKTOP-02 (auto-update) covered by plan 01

code.finding: Folder creation wraps IPNS keys for TEE — this is the reference pattern for file-level TEE enrollment to replicate

workflow: When the conversation is interrupted mid-agent-spawn, committed files on the feature branch survive — switching back to the branch restores full state without needing to redo work

Windows Tauri updater's download_and_install force-exits the app, which may conflict with FUSE unmount requirements — platform-specific guard may be needed but was accepted as reasonable behavior
